## Hinge · When is the bound reached? {#fv2-hinge .fv-lesson .proof-lesson }

```{=html}
<div data-module="hinge" data-correct="3" class="hinge numeric-choices"><p class="hinge-question">For non-zero vectors with <span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{a}|=2,\ |\underset{\sim}{b}|=3"></span>, which values of <span data-math="\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}"></span> give equality in <span data-math="|\underset{\sim}{a}\cdot\underset{\sim}{b}|\leq |\underset{\sim}{a}||\underset{\sim}{b}|"></span>?</p><div class="hinge-toolbar"><div class="time" role="timer" aria-label="Time remaining">1:00</div><div class="toolbar"><label>Seconds <select class="timer-duration" aria-label="Question duration"><option>30</option><option>45</option><option selected>60</option><option>90</option><option>120</option></select></label><button class="timer-start primary">Start</button><button class="reset-question">Reset</button></div></div><div class="choices"><button class="choice" data-answer="1" aria-pressed="false"><b>1</b><span><span data-math="6"></span> only</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="2" aria-pressed="false"><b>2</b><span><span data-math="-6"></span> only</span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="3" aria-pressed="false"><b>3</b><span>Both <span data-math="6"></span> and <span data-math="-6"></span></span></button><button class="choice" data-answer="4" aria-pressed="false"><b>4</b><span><span data-math="0"></span></span></button></div><div class="hinge-bottom"><p>Fist on chest. Think quietly.<br>On “show”, hold up 1–4 fingers.</p><button class="reveal-answer primary">Reveal answer</button></div><div class="hinge-explanation" hidden><strong>3.</strong> Both values have absolute value 6. ::: {.notes}
```
Correct answer 3: |6|=|−6|=6. Choice 1 overlooks opposite directions. Choice 2 overlooks the same direction. Choice 4 confuses perpendicularity with attaining the bound. Default 60 seconds, simultaneous 1–4 fingers only on the teacher’s cue, answer hidden until Reveal answer. Ready: proceed to Example 2.2. Divided: compare 0° and 180° with a partner, then vote again. Needs explanation: return to the visual and compare the signed dot product with its absolute value. Timer expiry does not reveal the answer.
:::
